operation.body: slash=1, non-slash=0; first nine class-word cells form a 9-bit integer
operation.format: zero-pad to three decimal digits to match CE serial presentation
operation.selector: one-slash tail depth 0/1/2 selects the corresponding decimal digit

difference: the E2 outputs differ only in class C, the same residue-84/residue-102 physical bit
classification: bounded in-domain derived interface with no independently identified downstream consumer
guardrail: Do not apply keypad, modulo, cipher, phone-number, coordinate, or plaintext transforms to these outputs without a new external cue.
